notes: Team ids are per season on gol.gg (team-stats URLs carry no season segment); every id was taken from or checked against the season-S16 list page and each page title was checked to read '<team> stats in S16' / 'in <split> Split (S16)'.

gol.gg's stats page has no team-level 'most picked champions' table. draft.picks / bans_by / bans_against / picked_against / presence are derived from the per-game draft log on the team's Draft tab (20 draft slots per team per game; grayscale icon = ban, colour icon = pick); the tab's own top-10 count tables (First Picked, Last Picked, Banned by/Against <code>) are kept verbatim under page_tables and agree with the derived counts.

Pick numbering: avg_pick_no / n_first_pick / n_last_pick count the team's own picks 1-5 in draft order (1 = the team's first pick of the game, 5 = its last pick); n_phase1 = picked in the first pick phase (3 of 5 picks). gol.gg's log orders the two rows by the game title, not by side, so only each team's own order is used, never the blue/red interleaving. Games whose draft shows no pick order on gol.gg (15-cell rows) count toward games/wins/bans but not toward the order metrics; n_order_known says how many of a champion's games had order data.

page_tables.banned_by_pct / banned_against_pct are the stats page's top-6 tables; Overall % is the share of all the team's games, and the Blue Side / Red Side rows are also expressed as a share of ALL games (they sum to Overall), not of games on that side.

stats.dragon_share_pct / herald_share_pct / baron_share_pct are the unlabeled percentages gol.gg prints in parentheses after 'Dragons / game', 'Herald / game', 'Nashors / game'; they match the team's share of that objective (taken / (taken + conceded)). gol.gg's team page gives NO first-dragon, first-herald or first-baron rate; those are null (not present).
First Tower, First Blood and 'Win Rate when ahead at 15 min' are percentages (0-100). Game time is 'mm:ss' plus avg_game_min as decimal minutes.

Champion names are gol.gg display names exactly as shown in img alt text (KSante, Kaisa, RekSai, Chogath, KogMaw, KhaZix, LeBlanc, Lee Sin, Jarvan IV, Wukong, Dr. Mundo...), the same spellings as data/golgg_players_2026.json.

players = the '<team> player's stats' table (status 'Last line-up' = current five, 'Subs' = everyone else who played); per-player champs carry games / wr / kda from the hover text, games = sum of the player's champion games.
tournaments_in_dropdown is the stats page's tournament filter list, which gol.gg does not filter by split, so it is the team's season-wide event list.

Not present on gol.gg team pages (null / absent): first dragon, first herald, first baron rates, team KDA, per-side average game time, team-level 'most picked' table, pick-priority per champion beyond the derived pick numbers.
